title: Dependency audit narrowed to direct packages
description: nuget.config declares an `auditMode` that stops at direct dependencies. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `auditMode` that stops at direct dependencies.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix an `auditMode` that stops at direct dependencies.
limitation: It matches an `auditMode` that stops at direct dependencies in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
